faq.description: Clear answers about guest edits, private images, credits, and account upgrades.
faq.title: Frequently asked questions

refundPolicy.question: How are refunds handled?
refundPolicy.answer: Refund eligibility depends on the applicable payment terms. Contact support with your billing details for review.

cancelSubscription.question: How do I cancel my subscription?
cancelSubscription.answer: You can cancel your subscription by visiting the billing page.

changePlan.question: Can I change my plan?
changePlan.answer: Yes, you can change your plan at any time by visiting the billing page.

freeTrial.question: Is there a free plan?
freeTrial.answer: Yes. The Free plan includes 25 monthly credits and access to Standard Edit.

realGeneration.question: Can I edit an image from the homepage?
realGeneration.answer: Yes. Upload a source image, describe the change, and continue into a temporary guest workspace to start one Standard edit without creating an account.

privateUploads.question: Are uploaded images public?
privateUploads.answer: No. Guest source images and results stay private and temporary; registered account media remains owner-scoped.

restrictions.question: What does “No Restrictions” mean here?
restrictions.answer: It means natural-language prompts, fewer template-only steps, private uploads, and transparent credits. Standard safety, legal, provider, and usage limits still apply.

formats.question: Which source-image formats can I upload?
formats.answer: The homepage accepts JPEG, PNG, and WebP images up to the file-size limit shown beside the uploader.

imageEditorHero.title: AI Image Editor With Prompts, Without the Usual Restrictions
imageEditorHero.subtitle: Upload your image, say exactly what should change, and start one private Standard edit from this page. No separate app and no account required.

beforeAfter.title: Compare the direction before you commit
beforeAfter.description: Drag the divider to inspect an original vector scene and its hand-authored edit direction. The same comparison pattern is used to make source and result easy to distinguish.
beforeAfter.disclaimer: This illustration demonstrates the interface; it is not a Provider quality claim.
beforeAfter.beforeAlt: Original vector illustration of a neutral reading studio

showcase.title: Start with a look. Make it unmistakably yours.
showcase.description: Explore original visual directions for interiors, products, portraits, lighting, food, and illustration. Every case includes a complete prompt you can reuse.
showcase.instruction: Choose a card to send its full prompt to the editor.
showcase.provenanceNote: Original images created with OpenAI image generation for inspiration. They are not claimed as EzPic model outputs; actual results depend on your source image and prompt.

mediterranean.title: Mediterranean quiet
mediterranean.prompt: Transform the room into a sunlit Mediterranean retreat with limewashed walls, warm oak furniture, soft linen textures, and olive accents. Preserve the original camera angle and architecture.
mediterranean.alt: Sunlit Mediterranean living room with limewashed walls and warm wood furniture

cobalt.title: Sculpted cobalt
cobalt.prompt: Replace the background with a sculptural sand-colored studio, add a shallow reflective water surface, and light the cobalt bottle with crisp directional sunlight. Keep the product shape and label area unchanged.
cobalt.alt: Cobalt glass bottle on a sculptural sand-colored pedestal

emerald.title: Emerald in the rain
emerald.prompt: Change only the jacket to deep emerald technical fabric with a soft satin sheen. Preserve the person, pose, clothing layers, wet street, and overcast city lighting.
emerald.alt: Fashion portrait of a person in an emerald jacket on a rain-darkened street

blueHour.title: Blue-hour cinema
blueHour.prompt: Relight the scene at deep blue hour with warm amber window glow, subtle wet-ground reflections, and restrained cinematic grain. Preserve all architecture, vehicle details, and framing.
blueHour.alt: Coastal motel and vintage convertible illuminated at blue hour

citrus.title: Citrus color story
citrus.prompt: Turn this dessert photo into a vibrant editorial composition with a lavender ceramic plate, coral linen, a deep plum surface, and sculpted window light. Keep the tart realistic and sharply detailed.
citrus.alt: Bright citrus tart on a lavender plate with coral linen

paperTrain.title: Paper-cut alpine
paperTrain.prompt: Reimagine the scene as handcrafted layered paper-cut art with visible paper fibers, precise dimensional shadows, alpine greens, a cobalt sky, and a tomato-red train. Preserve the route and mountain composition.
paperTrain.alt: Layered paper-cut illustration of a red train winding through alpine mountains
